blockers.issue: Only exact lowercase top-level md5 and sha256 keys are added to the digest set. The generic guard lowercases and removes hyphens, then exempts normalized sha256 without adding the supplied value. For example, top-level sha-256 or SHA256 is silently ignored. Uppercase MD5 and case variants of digest/digestType can also bypass validation. A file may therefore pass without comparing a supplied digest.
blockers.minimal_fix: Parse supported top-level checksum aliases case-insensitively and compare them, or fail closed on every checksum-like top-level key not explicitly parsed. Add offline fixtures for a sha-256 alias and uppercase MD5 that assert compare-or-stop.
